Use AquaSense only for lawful aquarium monitoring and care. Keep your sign-in credentials and registered device credentials private. Do not attempt to access another person's account, aquarium, or device, interfere with the service, or submit readings for a device or aquarium you are not authorized to use.

Your responsibilities

You are responsible for maintaining aquarium equipment, checking sensor calibration and water conditions, and deciding what care actions to take. Do not rely on a single sensor, dashboard alert, or general information as the only basis for animal-care decisions.

Readings and care information

AquaSense displays sensor readings and general aquarium information to help you monitor your setup. Sensor measurements may be inaccurate, delayed, incomplete, or unavailable. The dashboard and its recommendations are informational and are not a guarantee of water quality, fish health, or animal-care outcomes. Check important conditions with suitable independent tests and use your judgment.

You are responsible for activity under your account and for providing accurate account information. Aquarium access is assigned by AquaSense administrators. Do not share your account or device credentials. Access may be suspended or removed to protect the service, its users, or aquarium data.
